description: Location-independent synthetic stress profiles. Production annual simulations use local historical or TMY weather; IECC climate zones never select these profiles.

profiles.physical_rationale: Fixed winter stress profile retained only for deterministic tests and demonstrations.
profiles.client_description: Synthetic winter stress scenario; it is not selected from a climate zone and is not used for the annual local-weather estimate.
sources: Values preserved from the former generic temperate test profile
